title: Prowler: pyasn1 has quadratic-time denial of service in constructed string and indefinite-length ANY decoding…
description: pyasn1 versions 0.6.4 and earlier contain a quadratic-time denial of service vulnerability in the decoding of constructed OCTET STRINGs, constructed character strings, and indefinite-length ANY types. The decoder repeatedly concatenates fragments inefficiently, causing CPU usage to grow quadratically with the number of fragments. This can lead to CPU exhaustion if an attacker supplies crafted ASN.1 input to an affected decoder. The vulnerability affects BER and CER decoding paths and certain non-conforming DER inputs. No confidentiality or integrity impact is reported. The issue is fixed in version 5.47.0.
